verdict.rationale: Copilot is built into GitHub.com. It answers questions about a user's codebase, researches repositories, and reviews changes with suggested edits that can be applied in a couple of clicks, so users get AI insights and suggestions from their own repository data inside the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, evidence of AI insights over non-code data (issues, project or activity analytics).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: GitHub Copilot is built into GitHub, so you can use it without installing anything.
It suggests code as you type, answers questions about a codebase, reviews your changes, and works on tasks you assign it.
GitHub Copilot can review your code and provide feedback. Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
Understand code and work faster by asking questions and assigning coding tasks to Copilot in the cloud without leaving GitHub.
Explore your repositories, plan changes, and delegate coding tasks to GitHub Copilot without leaving GitHub.com.
